description: Capability for the splash window. Tauri v2 scopes capabilities per window label — `default.json` only targets ["main"], so without this the splash webview would have no permissions at all, including the `listen` permission it needs to receive boot progress events. Kept separate (and deliberately minimal, just `core:default`) because the splash never calls a plugin command like `opener:*`; it only listens for `boot:status` and invokes our own `finish_boot` command, which — being one of our own `#[tauri::command]` functions rather than a plugin command — needs no permission entry at all.
